name: official_constraints_data_gap
crs_note: Exchange coordinates EPSG:4326; metric calculations EPSG:4548.
note_zh: 公开资料包尚无可正式使用的控规、道路红线、权属、市政、消防与文保约束几何；本文件的 features 故意为空，不以推断线替代官方控制。空集本身不是缺项：`scripts/validate_submission.py` 的 `validate_empty_constraints_declaration` 明确「inventing one is worse than leaving the set empty」，并要求在有可引用的官方或已清权几何之前保持空集。下面的 data_gap 用来回答空集之后的问题——缺的是哪几层、各自卡住哪几项指标、什么条件触发复算。
note_en: The public site package still contains no usable official geometry for regulatory control, road right-of-way, ownership, utilities, fire access or heritage protection. The feature list is deliberately empty; no inferred line substitutes for official control. Emptiness is not an omission: `validate_empty_constraints_declaration` in `scripts/validate_submission.py` states that inventing constraint geometry is worse than leaving the set empty, and asks for the set to stay empty until citable official or cleared geometry exists. The data_gap block below answers what comes after the empty set — which layers are missing, which metrics each one blocks, and what triggers recomputation.

data_gap.declaration_basis: brief/site-package 公开资料包与征集公告；截至本版本仓库未发布上述任一官方图层。
data_gap.fabrication_policy_zh: 本包不为下列任一层生成替代几何，也不把任何推断面标注为 official_constraint。需要空间判断时，一律降级为「可校验的引导」写进正文，并把对应指标保持 unassigned。
data_gap.fabrication_policy_en: This package generates no substitute geometry for any layer below, and labels no inferred surface `official_constraint`. Where a spatial judgement is needed, it is downgraded to a checkable design principle in the main text and the corresponding metric is left unassigned.

missing_layers.label_zh: 官方精确总体设计范围
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 全部面积、比例与长度类指标只能以临时边界复算，属模型量而非法定量。
missing_layers.blocks_en: All area, ratio and length metrics can only be recomputed against a provisional boundary, and remain model quantities rather than statutory ones.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 官方边界几何与坐标系发布后，九类几何、指标、中英图件与四套 PDF 一并整包复算。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Once the official boundary geometry and coordinate system are released, all nine geometry layers, the metrics, the bilingual figures and the four PDF sets are recomputed together.

missing_layers.label_zh: 审定控制性详细规划（强度、高度、退界、密度）
missing_layers.label_en: Approved regulatory detailed plan (intensity, height, setback, density)
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 开发强度与体量类结论无法成立，本方案只给可校验的形态引导，不给数值。
missing_layers.blocks_en: No development-intensity or massing conclusion can stand; the proposal gives checkable form guidance instead of figures.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 控规批复公开且计容规则口径明确后，按控规单元逐项赋值，不做全带平均。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Once the approval is published and the countable-floor-area basis is stated, values are assigned per control-plan unit, with no belt-wide averaging.

missing_layers.blocks_zh: 二十个更新单元只能作为类型学与空间供给表达，不构成确权清单；任何落点均待授权。
missing_layers.blocks_en: The twenty renewal cells can only express typology and spatial supply, never a title schedule; every siting decision awaits authorisation.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 权属与租约边界清权后，逐单元核对保留、修缮、临时植入与拆除研究四类处置。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Once ownership and lease boundaries are cleared, each cell is rechecked against the four dispositions: retain, repair, temporary insertion, demolition study.

missing_layers.label_zh: 道路红线与道路用地面
missing_layers.label_en: Road right-of-way lines and road land area
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 断面只能规定次序与相邻关系，不能给尺寸；三处慢行断点不给桥隧形式与跨度结论。
missing_layers.blocks_en: Sections can only fix sequence and adjacency, never dimensions; the three slow-mobility breaks carry no bridge or tunnel form or span conclusion.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 道路红线发布后，分子与分母须来自同一发布批次再计算比值。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Once right-of-way lines are released, numerator and denominator must come from the same release batch before any ratio is computed.

missing_layers.label_zh: 现状纵断面与高程（含北五环上跨段）
missing_layers.label_en: Existing longitudinal profile and elevation, including the North Fifth Ring overpass segment
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 连续无高差步行面目前是开放前提而非实测结论；未取得高程前不推算最大纵坡。
missing_layers.blocks_en: The continuous step-free walking surface is currently a precondition for opening, not a surveyed result; no maximum gradient is inferred before elevations exist.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 现状纵断面测量完成且垂直基准记录后，按 pending_field_checks 列出的点位逐处复核。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Once the profile survey is complete and its vertical datum recorded, each location listed in pending_field_checks is checked individually.

missing_layers.label_zh: 文物保护范围与建设控制地带
missing_layers.label_en: Heritage protection zones and construction control areas
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 四处地标与全部临时构件的落位不给结论；文保范围内一律只用可逆、可撤除做法。
missing_layers.blocks_en: No siting conclusion is given for the four landmarks or any temporary component; inside heritage zones only reversible, removable methods are admitted.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 文保主管部门发布保护范围与建控地带后，逐处复核地标与构件落位。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Once the heritage authority publishes protection zones and control areas, every landmark and component siting is rechecked.

missing_layers.label_zh: 生态本底、水文与防洪断面
missing_layers.label_en: Ecological baseline, hydrology and flood-control sections
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 概念绿地比例与公共交接面比例是设计几何的内部量，不是现状绿地率或法定指标。
missing_layers.blocks_en: The conceptual green ratio and public-interface ratio are internal quantities of the design geometry, not an existing green ratio or a statutory indicator.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 生态本底、树木、水文与地形调查到位后重新划定并复算。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Redrawn and recomputed once the ecological baseline, tree, hydrology and terrain surveys are available.

missing_layers.label_zh: 市政容量、消防与产业运营基线（无对应图层码）
missing_layers.label_en: Utility capacity, fire access and an industry operating baseline (no corresponding layer code)
missing_layers.blocks_zh: 临时设施不接入未经核定的市政系统；产业绩效四项与交接时间两项均无基线，一律保持待测。
missing_layers.blocks_en: Temporary facilities connect to no unverified utility system; the four industry-performance metrics and the two handover-time metrics have no baseline and all stay unvalued.
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_zh: 市政与消防容量经专业核定、且授权后产生第一批真实交接账后，按各自测量协议赋值。
missing_layers.recompute_trigger_en: Values are assigned per measurement protocol once utility and fire capacity are professionally verified and the first real handover ledgers exist after authorisation.

pending_field_checks.note_zh: 以下点位不是约束几何，也不代表任何官方控制；它们是**本包自身几何的复算结果**，用来指明现状纵断面测量到位后必须逐处复核的位置。任何人可用 geometry/roads.geojson 复算：主轴 ROAD-001 与八条支线 ROAD-002…ROAD-009 的交点即前八处。
pending_field_checks.note_en: The locations below are not constraint geometry and represent no official control. They are recomputed from this package's own geometry to mark where a profile survey must check once it exists. Anyone can recompute them from geometry/roads.geojson: the first eight are the intersections of the spine ROAD-001 with the eight stitch links ROAD-002 to ROAD-009.
pending_field_checks.derivation: intersect(ROAD-001, ROAD-00N) for N in 2..9, EPSG:4326

slow_mobility_breaks.label_zh: 南端进入大钟寺方向的过街
北端与既有城市路网的衔接
slow_mobility_breaks.label_en: Northern connection to the existing road network
Continuity across the North Fifth Ring
slow_mobility_breaks.derivation: ROAD-001 北端点（lat 40.0255）与临时范围北边界（lat 40.0265，对应文字四至的北五环路）之间的未接通段
slow_mobility_breaks.note_zh: 主轴几何本身止于范围北边界以南约 111 米，这段未接通正是本方案点名的第三处慢行断点。不给桥隧形式、跨度或工程可行性结论，须由交通与市政专业依实测与法定程序确定。
slow_mobility_breaks.note_en: The spine geometry stops roughly 111 m south of the provisional northern boundary; that unconnected stretch is precisely the third slow-mobility break named in the proposal. No bridge or tunnel form, span or feasibility conclusion is offered; this rests with transport and utility professionals under statutory process.
